description: Delete a tournament as its organizer (needs manage_code). PREVIEW FIRST: call without confirm_preview_id to get a preview_id and a summary of what will be deleted (players, matches, live screens) — nothing is written. Show the preview to the user, then call again with {tournament_id, code, confirm_preview_id} to delete. Deleting removes the tournament from search and public pages immediately; its record and audit trail stay in the database for the operator, and there is no undelete via MCP — treat this as permanent. Use it to clean up test events and cancelled tournaments.

confirm_preview_id.description: preview_id from the preview call — pass only to delete that exact tournament

name: delete_tournament
